```{=html}

<!-- HERO SECTION                                    -->

<section style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2B2B2B 0%, #0a1525 50%, #2B2B2B 100%); min-height: 40vh; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 4rem 1.5rem; position: relative; overflow: hidden;">
  <div style="position: absolute; inset: 0; opacity: 0.05; background-image: url('data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns=%22http://www.w3.org/2000/svg%22 width=%2260%22 height=%2260%22><path d=%22M60 0L0 0 0 60%22 fill=%22none%22 stroke=%22%23D4A017%22 stroke-width=%220.5%22/></svg>'); background-size: 60px 60px;"></div>

  <div style="position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: left;">
    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 1rem;">Contact</p>

    <h1 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(2rem, 4.5vw, 3rem); font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; margin-bottom: 1.25rem;">
      Let's <span style="color: #D4A017;">Connect</span>
    </h1>

    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.15rem); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); line-height: 1.7; max-width: 580px;">
      We'd love to hear from you. Whether you have a question, partnership inquiry, or simply want to say hello — reach out and we'll respond promptly.
    </p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section style="background-color: #0B1F3B; padding: 1.75rem 1.5rem;">
  <div class="contact-info-strip" style="max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: min(3rem, 5vw); flex-wrap: wrap;">
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
      <span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">📧</span>
      <div>
        <span style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);">Email</span>
        <a href="mailto:info@yetcompassion.org" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none;">info@yetcompassion.org</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
      <span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">📍</span>
      <div>
        <span style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);">Location</span>
        <span style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #FFFFFF;">Nashville, Tennessee</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem;">
      <span style="font-size: 1.25rem;">🕐</span>
      <div>
        <span style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);">Hours</span>
        <span style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #FFFFFF;">Evenings & Weekends</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<!-- FORM + INFO TWO-COLUMN                          -->
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<section class="reveal-on-scroll" style="background-color: #FFFFFF; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem;">
  <div class="contact-form-grid" style="max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; align-items: start;">
  <style>
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
      .contact-form-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr !important; gap: 3rem !important; }
    }
  </style>

    <!-- Contact Form -->
    <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 2rem;">
      <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600;">Send a Message</h2>
      <div style="width: 60px; height: 3px; background-color: #0B1F3B; margin-bottom: 1.5rem;"></div>

      <form name="contact" method="POST" data-netlify="true" netlify-honeypot="bot-field" action="/contact-success.html" id="contact-form" style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem;">
        <input type="hidden" name="form-name" value="contact" />
        <!-- Honeypot field — hidden from humans, catches bots -->
        <p style="display: none;"><label>Don't fill this out: <input name="bot-field" /></label></p>

        <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1rem;">
          <div>
            <label for="contact-name" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Full Name *</label>
            <input type="text" id="contact-name" name="name" required autocomplete="name" minlength="2" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
            <span class="field-error" id="name-error" style="display: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #c0392b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">Please enter your name.</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <label for="contact-email" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Email *</label>
            <input type="email" id="contact-email" name="email" required autocomplete="email" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
            <span class="field-error" id="email-error" style="display: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #c0392b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">Please enter a valid email address.</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="contact-phone" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Phone <span style="font-weight: 400; color: #8A8985;">(optional)</span></label>
          <input type="tel" id="contact-phone" name="phone" autocomplete="tel" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="contact-subject" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Subject *</label>
          <select id="contact-subject" name="subject" required style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
            <option value="">Select a topic</option>
            <option value="general">General Inquiry</option>
            <option value="volunteer">Volunteering</option>
            <option value="partnership">Partnership Opportunity</option>
            <option value="donation">Donation Question</option>
            <option value="programs">Programs Information</option>
            <option value="media">Media & Press</option>
            <option value="other">Other</option>
          </select>
          <span class="field-error" id="subject-error" style="display: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #c0392b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">Please select a subject.</span>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label for="contact-message" style="display: block; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 0.4rem;">Message *</label>
          <textarea id="contact-message" name="message" rows="5" required minlength="10" placeholder="How can we help?" style="width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; background: #FFFFFF; resize: vertical; transition: border-color 200ms ease;"></textarea>
          <span class="field-error" id="message-error" style="display: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; color: #c0392b; margin-top: 0.25rem;">Please enter a message (at least 10 characters).</span>
        </div>

        <!-- Form status messages -->
        <div id="form-status" style="display: none; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem;"></div>

        <button type="submit" id="contact-submit-btn" style="align-self: flex-start; background-color: #0B1F3B; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.75rem 2rem; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms ease; min-height: 48px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem;">
          <span id="btn-text">Send Message</span>
          <span id="btn-spinner" style="display: none; width: 18px; height: 18px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-top-color: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 0.6s linear infinite;"></span>
        </button>
      </form>

      <style>
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .field-error { display: block; }
        input:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown), textarea:invalid:not(:placeholder-shown), select:invalid {
          border-color: #c0392b !important;
        }
      </style>

      <script>
      (function() {
        var form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
        var submitBtn = document.getElementById('contact-submit-btn');
        var btnText = document.getElementById('btn-text');
        var btnSpinner = document.getElementById('btn-spinner');
        var formStatus = document.getElementById('form-status');

        form.addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
          // Clear previous errors
          document.querySelectorAll('.field-error').forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = 'none'; });
          formStatus.style.display = 'none';

          var valid = true;
          var name = document.getElementById('contact-name');
          var email = document.getElementById('contact-email');
          var subject = document.getElementById('contact-subject');
          var message = document.getElementById('contact-message');

          if (!name.value.trim() || name.value.trim().length < 2) {
            document.getElementById('name-error').style.display = 'block';
            valid = false;
          }
          if (!email.value.trim() || !email.validity.valid) {
            document.getElementById('email-error').style.display = 'block';
            valid = false;
          }
          if (!subject.value) {
            document.getElementById('subject-error').style.display = 'block';
            valid = false;
          }
          if (!message.value.trim() || message.value.trim().length < 10) {
            document.getElementById('message-error').style.display = 'block';
            valid = false;
          }

          if (!valid) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
          }

          // Show loading state
          btnText.textContent = 'Sending...';
          btnSpinner.style.display = 'inline-block';
          submitBtn.disabled = true;
          submitBtn.style.opacity = '0.7';
        });
      })();
      </script>
    </div>

    <!-- Right Column: Info Cards -->
    <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem;">

      <!-- Address Card -->
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; border-left: 4px solid #0B1F3B;">
        <h4 style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #0B1F3B; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Mailing Address</h4>
        <address style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; font-style: normal; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0;">
          Y.E.T. Compassion<br>
          P.O. Box 680262<br>
          Franklin, TN 37068-0262
        </address>
      </div>

      <!-- Office Hours Card -->
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; border-left: 4px solid #D4A017;">
        <h4 style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #D4A017; margin-bottom: 0.5rem;">Office Hours</h4>
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0;">
          Evenings & Weekends
        </p>
      </div>

      <!-- Social Card -->
      <div style="background: #F7F6F2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; border-left: 4px solid #38BDF8;">
        <h4 style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #38BDF8; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">Connect With Us</h4>
        <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; flex-wrap: wrap;">
          <a href="https://www.facebook.com/YetCompassion" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2B2B2B; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; transition: all 200ms ease;">
            Facebook
          </a>
          <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/gai-luom-155b83b3/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 500; color: #2B2B2B; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0.75rem; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; transition: all 200ms ease;">
            LinkedIn
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Response Time -->
      <div style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(31,94,59,0.06), rgba(212,160,23,0.06)); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; text-align: center;">
        <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0;">
          We typically respond within <strong style="color: #0B1F3B;">24–48 hours</strong>. For urgent matters, please include "URGENT" in your subject line.
        </p>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <style>
    form input:focus,
    form select:focus,
    form textarea:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: #0B1F3B !important;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,94,59,0.12);
    }
    form button:hover {
      background-color: #122D52 !important;
    }
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      div[style*="grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.8fr"] {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }
      div[style*="grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr"][style*="gap: 1rem"] {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr !important;
      }
    }
  </style>
</section>

<section style="background-color: #2B2B2B; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem; text-align: center;">
  <div style="max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto;">
    <p style="font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem); color: #D4A017; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0;">
      "Therefore encourage one another and build one another up, just as you are doing."
    </p>
    <span style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #8A8985; margin-top: 1rem; display: block;">
      — 1 Thessalonians 5:11 (ESV)
    </span>
  </div>
</section>

<section style="background-color: #F7F6F2; padding: 3.5rem 1.5rem; text-align: center;">
  <div style="max-width: 700px; margin: 0 auto;">
    <h2 style="font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 3vw, 2.25rem); color: #2B2B2B; margin-bottom: 1rem; font-weight: 600;">
      Other Ways to Connect
    </h2>
    <p style="font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #5A5955; line-height: 1.7; margin-bottom: 2rem;">
      Beyond sending a message, you can support our mission through volunteering, partnership, or financial giving.
    </p>
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap;">
      <a href="/donate.html" class="btn-gold">Support Our Mission</a>
      <a href="/get-involved.html" class="btn-green">Get Involved</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
